watch.en: Keep the liquid gently moving, with no bubbles at all.
watch.de: Die Flüssigkeit sanft in Bewegung halten, ganz ohne Blasen.

why.en: Slow heating lets the proteins set without squeezing out moisture.
why.de: Langsames Erhitzen lässt das Eiweiß stocken, ohne dass Feuchtigkeit herausgepresst wird.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 7.2 The Cooking Techniques - Poaching, section Poaching is Ideally Done
sources.sentence: The liquid should be gently moving, but it should not be bubbling at all.

sources.title: Culinary Foundations (Cheramie and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 7.2 The Cooking Techniques - Poaching, section Poaching is Patience
sources.sentence: Poaching allows the proteins in foods to uncoil, or denature, slowly, without squeezing out moisture.
